turns.customer: Hi, the Riverwalk sandals in order #1376 are a size too big. I only tried them on indoors. How do I send them back?
turns.reply:
Your Riverwalk Camp Sandals are eligible for return until October 11, 2026, as long as they are unused and in their original packaging. 

To send them back, you can generate a return label in your account and mail them to us. Once the warehouse receives the package, your refund will be issued. Thanks for understanding.
